SUMMARY.verdict: GEOX is MCP-conformant. The 7 WARN items are optional features (title/icons on tools, resource names, Origin validation). The 5 custom extensions are governance layers built ON TOP of MCP, not spec violations.
SUMMARY.key_finding: The MCP transport and lifecycle are used correctly. The governance envelope, lane enforcement, and kernel bridging are custom architecture built on top of MCP, not part of the protocol. This is architecturally sound — MCP provides the transport, arifOS provides the governance.
